ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "client_secret": p('zsmart-sapi.security.client-secret'), "client_id": p('zsmart-sapi.security.client-id'), "name": attributes.headers.name, "X-CORRELATION-ID": attributes.headers."X-CORRELATION-ID", "source": attributes.headers.source, "systemId": attributes.headers.systemId }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn="everywhere" var zsmartResponse = payload.result.result --- { codeResponse: payload.status default "200", messageResponse: payload.message default "Success", resultCode: zsmartResponse.resultCode, resultMsg: zsmartResponse.resultMsg, transactionId: zsmartResponse.transactionID, disputes: zsmartResponse.disputeExParam map ((dispute) -> { disputeId: dispute.disputeID, charge: dispute.charge, adjustId: dispute.adjustID, resultMessage: dispute.resultMsg }) }
